newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria sets up panel on headless bodies riots.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria sets up panel on headless bodies riots.

text.p: Nigeria's military government on Thursday set up a panel to investigate riots sparked by the discovery of headless bodies in the eastern city of Owerri.
"The seven-man panel will determine immediate and remote causes of, and ascertain extent of damages and injuries sustained by people during the disturbances," national radio said.
The riots began on Tuesday after the discovery of a boy's headless corpse in the grounds at a hotel. His suspected killer died in police custody at the weekend.
Rioting continued on Wednesday after two other human heads were discovered inside a church.

"Several hundred youths defied a state of emergency in their determined fight against ritual murders and other criminals even as government imposed a 6 p.m. to 6 a.m. curfew," The Champion newspaper said.
The pentecostal Overcomers Church, which the crowd said had been financed by a fraudster, was burned to the ground after the heads were found inside.
The Daily Times said more than 25 buildings and 30 cars had been set on fire by the demonstrators.
Residents said on Thursday that calm had returned to the city.
"It's all quiet now. Things are back to normal but there is a heavy police presence on the streets," one journalist said by telephone from the city.
